title: segmentation message
description: Instance masks, filled at the viewer's mask opacity, each with a caption in its class color. Version 1 of the contract in docs/contracts.md.

mask.description: A polygon or an RLE mask, as mask_format says.

bbox.description: Places the caption and drives the region-of-interest filter. Optional for a polygon, whose extent is used when absent; required for an RLE mask, which is stretched over it.

confidence.description: Compared with the viewer's confidence threshold; a segment without one always passes.

id.description: Names the segment in the browser console's warnings; not drawn.

show_rectangle.description: true also draws bbox's outline. Only the boolean true does.

polygon.description: The outline as [[x, y], ...] in video pixels, at least three points; it is closed by itself.

rle.description: An uncompressed run-length mask covering the bbox rectangle, not the frame. The runs go over the mask column by column (column-major), the first run is background, and runs then alternate. At most 2048 × 2048 cells.

size.description: [height, width] of the mask in cells.

counts.description: The run lengths, a JSON array of integers; not the compressed string pycocotools' mask.encode returns.
